mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_generation (ucode, job_type, milestone_seq, input_photo_seq, status, prompt, point_used, cost_usd, is_free_retry, retry_count) VALUES (#{ucode}, #{jobType}, #{milestoneSeq}, #{inputPhotoSeq}, #{status}, #{prompt}, #{pointUsed}, #{costUsd}, #{isFreeRetry}, #{retryCount})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_generation WHERE milestone_seq = #{milestoneSeq} ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_generation SET status = 'COMPLETED', result_photo_seq = #{resultPhotoSeq}, fal_request_id = #{falRequestId}, cost_usd = #{costUsd}, completed_at = NOW() WHERE gen_seq = #{genSeq}
UPDATE ai_generation SET status = 'FAILED', error_msg = #{errorMsg}, completed_at = NOW() WHERE gen_seq = #{genSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_generation WHERE ucode = #{ucode} AND DATE(requested_at) = CURDATE()
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) FROM ai_generation WHERE DATE(requested_at) = CURDATE() AND status = 'COMPLETED'
